info.title: GemstoneAI Enterprise API
info.description:
The GemstoneAI Enterprise API: the pricing and verification layer for jewelry.

* **Scan API** (`/scans`): today's GemstoneAI scan result, enhanced for businesses. Send 1-5 photos
  of a piece of jewelry or a loose stone (plus anything you already know) and get the
  identification, the price context and the comparables behind it, each tagged as an asking price
  or a realized sale.
* **Intake** (`/intake`): the scan plus your routing rules: list, review, lab or decline.
* **Verify** (`/verify`): the scan plus risk checks on a listing, claim or appraisal.

Conventions:

* **Authentication:** `Authorization: Bearer gsk_...` (or `X-API-Key`). Keys are scoped per product.
* **Sandbox:** `gsk_test_` keys return example results; responses carry `synthetic_data: true`.
* **No guessing:** no price with fewer than 5 comparables, or when the item can't be identified;
  the reason is always given.
* **Audit:** every result is stored and retrievable by id, with the scan it was based on.
* **Versioned:** every result is stamped with the scan `model_version`; you can pin one.
* **Idempotency:** send `Idempotency-Key` on POSTs to make retries safe.

post.summary: Scan a piece of jewelry or a loose stone
post.description: Today's GemstoneAI scan result, in one response: the identification (observations, alternatives, open questions, next evidence), the price context, and the comparables behind it (each an asking price or a realized sale). Send 1-5 photos of one item, plus any details you already know. **No price with fewer than 5 comparables** or when the item can't be identified; the reason is always given. If the scan is still running, the response is `202` with `status: processing`: retrieve it with `GET /scans/{scan_id}`. Every scan is stored and retrievable.

post.summary: Submit a CSV of items to scan in batch
post.description: Upload a CSV (multipart field `file`), one item per row. Required column: `photo_urls` (1-5 public https links separated by `|`). Optional columns, passed to the scan as details: `row_id`, `item_type`, `metal_type`, `metal_purity`, `metal_weight_grams`, `brand`, `signed`, `era`, `condition`, `lab`, `lab_report_number`, `notes`. The job runs asynchronously; poll the status endpoint, then download the results CSV.

post.summary: Risk-check a listing, claim or appraisal
post.description: Scans the item, then checks the subject's stated value and photos against the scan and this account's history. Returns a 0-100 risk score, the checks that fired with their evidence, and a suggested action. A risk signal for review, not an authentication or certification.

put.description: Events: `intake.item.completed`, `verify.check.completed`, `verify.check.flagged` (action is not `allow`) and `batch.completed`. Deliveries are signed with `GemstoneAI-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>`, an HMAC-SHA256 of `<t>.<raw body>` with your secret. The secret is returned once, when the endpoint is created or `rotate_secret` is true.

price_type.description: 'realized' = completed sale; 'asking' = list price, not a transaction.

alternatives.title: Alternatives
alternatives.description: What else it could be, with probability.

review.description: The latest final call by a reviewer, if any.

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Who made the call, e.g. an email or staff id.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: What the specialist actually decided for this item.

prefill.title: Prefill

list_max_value.title: List Max Value
list_max_value.description: List directly only when the high end is at or below this.

min_confidence_to_list.title: Min Confidence To List

lab_min_value.title: Lab Min Value
lab_min_value.description: Send to lab when the low end is at or above this.

decline_below_value.title: Decline Below Value
decline_below_value.description: Decline when the high end is below this.

lab_spread_ratio.title: Lab Spread Ratio
lab_spread_ratio.description: Send to lab when a lab report is suggested and high >= this x low.

processing_now.title: Processing Now
processing_now.description: Records whose scan is still running (any date).

agreement_rate.title: Agreement Rate
agreement_rate.description: Share of reviewed items where the final call matched the routing.

list_correction_rate.title: List Correction Rate
list_correction_rate.description: Pilot metric: share of reviewed List-routed items a specialist changed.

signed.title: Signed
signed.description: Bears the maker's signature or mark.

lab.title: Lab
lab.description: Lab of a report for the item or its main stone.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Anything else, e.g. from a catalogue or appraisal.

ItemDetails.title: ItemDetails
ItemDetails.description: What you already know about the item. Every field is optional; all are passed to the scan.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: What the figure represents, e.g. retail replacement.

agrees.title: Agrees

previous.title: Previous
previous.description: Earlier calls on this record, newest first.

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: 1-5 photos of the same item: front, side, and any stamps inside the band or on the clasp.

details.description: Optional. What you already know, passed to the scan as hints.

model_version.title: Model Version
